# New API routes in version 2

`W1` · Coding rule

New mobile/MCP endpoints go in routes/api.php inside $api->version('v2') and the jwt.refresh group (unless explicitly public); controllers in app/Api/V2/Controllers/. Never add to or edit V1

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-web|Web app coding rules]].
